description: Get a personal Rhapsody share link and ready-to-post copy in one call. No account, identity, owner approval, wallet or subscription. Creates only a public attribution code; performs no send and grants no external permissions. Choose to post using your existing allowed tools; unpaid. Reuse the returned link. Optional random idempotency_key prevents duplicate links on retry.

idempotency_key.description: Optional random UUID for retries; never a credential.

name: pag_share_link
